case.complaintText: I ordered the black ceramic mug set but received a blue one instead.

attachments.extractedNotes: Blue ceramic mug set visible, does not match ordered black variant.
Order confirmation shows SKU MUGSET-CERAMIC-BLK (black variant).

resolutionProposal.rationale: Wrong-item complaint with complete evidence (received-item photo + invoice). Policy requires shipping the correct item and issuing a prepaid return label (Complaint Guide 5.2). This is the third wrong-item case for this SKU in 30 days, so also flagged for supplier review.

policySource.excerpt: 5.2 Confirmed wrong-item cases are resolved by shipping the correct item and issuing a prepaid return label for the incorrect item.

customerReplyDraft.text: We're sorry about the mix-up. We're shipping the correct black ceramic mug set today and have emailed you a prepaid return label for the blue set.
customerReplyDraft.internalSummaryEn: Wrong-item case, complete evidence, correct item to be shipped plus prepaid return label. Third occurrence for this SKU in 30 days — flagged for supplier review.
